::: {#exm-pairs-table}
#### The table of the checker

The state-transition table (@def-transition-table) of the DFA $A$ of @exm-pairs-dfa is

| state | $\mathtt{a}$ | $\mathtt{b}$ |
|:---|:---:|:---:|
| $\to * \, q_0$ | $q_1$ | $q_0$ |
| $q_1$ | $q_2$ | $q_0$ |
| $q_2$ | $q_2$ | $q_2$ |

The row of the dead state (@def-dead-state) $q_2$ is $q_2$ in every column.

:::
